recipes.name: Balsamic Vinegar Reduction
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the balsamic vinegar, and sugar if using, and bring to a boil over high heat. When it starts to boil, reduce the temperature to maintain a simmer.
Cook the vinegar down, stirring occasionally until it's about a third of the original volume, which should take about 13 to 15 minutes.
Allow the reduction to cool completely before transferring to a glass jar. The reduction will continue to thicken as it cools. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Storage Store in the fridge for up to 2 months.
